name: @wippy-session/wippy-form-answers
title: Session Form Answers
description: Invisible carrier element the Session server writes into a user's chat message after they answer a form, so the raw JSON answer record stays readable to the agent without ever being shown to the user.

wippy.description: Invisible carrier element. The Session server writes it into a user's chat message after a form is answered, with the JSON answer record (`form_id`, `form_version`, `title`, `late`, `answers`) in the `record` attribute. It renders nothing, so the record stays in the raw message text for the agent. `record` is declared as a prop so the Host's sanitizer keeps the attribute. Agents must never write this tag.

record.description: The self-contained JSON answer record (form_id, form_version, title, late, answers) as a single-line string, written into this attribute by the Session server immediately after a form is answered. The server escapes `'`, `<`, `>`, and `&` inside the JSON so the attribute value round-trips through HTML parsing intact; getAttribute('record') returns it already unescaped. Agents never write this attribute themselves.
